name: Yangle Ma
tagline: AI engineer · Multimodal learning & reproducible experiments
bio: I work on multimodal sentiment analysis, with a focus on reliable training pipelines and reproducible evaluation.

projects.description: Text, audio and vision sentiment modeling in Python and PyTorch on CH-SIMS v2.0 and CMU-MOSEI. The repository includes matched baselines, training and resume support, independent evaluation, and documented negative results. The current routing candidate does not consistently outperform its matched controls.
projects.name: Multimodal Sentiment Fusion

contributions.summary: Fixed missing-face features, single-sample output handling and non-finite predictions; added English and Chinese README documentation.
